site.name: Unpaid Reviews
site.description: Independent reviews of products, travel, restaurants and wine. Paid for by the reviewer: no affiliate links, no sponsorships, no gifts.

categories.name: Products
categories.blurb: Things bought at normal price and used long enough to know.

categories.name: Travel
categories.blurb: Places I paid to visit, with the real costs, crowds and logistics.

categories.name: Restaurants
categories.blurb: Meals I paid for, usually more than once, ordered like any customer.

categories.name: Wine
categories.blurb: Bottles I bought and drank, scored blind to price where I can and always with the cost disclosed.

reviews.title: Sample Product Review: Example Kettle
reviews.subject: Example Kettle
reviews.verdict: One-sentence bottom line goes here: who it is for, and who should skip it.
reviews.who_for: Say who gets the most out of this, in one or two sentences.
reviews.method: State how long you used it and how. Specifics beat adjectives.
reviews.acquired: Bought at full retail price with my own money.
flaws: A weakness that will not stop most people buying it
skip: Alternatives you tried and would not recommend, and why
body: Longer write-up goes here. Compare it to alternatives you actually used.
Say what changed your mind during testing.

reviews.title: Sample Product Review: Example Backpack
reviews.subject: Example Backpack
reviews.verdict: A mixed result still needs a clear verdict: what to buy instead.
reviews.who_for: Describe the narrow group it works for.
reviews.method: Three weeks of daily commuting, including two rainy days.
reviews.acquired: Bought online at the normal listed price. No discount code.
skip: The larger size: heavy even when empty
body: Explain the zipper problem in detail, so readers can judge whether it matters to them.

reviews.title: Sample Travel Review: Example Coastal Town
reviews.subject: Example Coastal Town
reviews.verdict: Say when to go, how long to stay, and what to skip.
reviews.who_for: Travelers who like walking and quiet evenings.
reviews.method: Four days in the shoulder season. Stayed in a mid-range hotel, used local transit.
reviews.acquired: Self-funded trip. No tourism-board hosting, press rates or free stays.
worked: What made the trip worth it
flaws: Crowds, costs or logistics worth knowing before you book
body: Cover timing, cost and the practical details a visitor needs.
Be honest about what disappointed you.

reviews.title: Sample Travel Review: Example Mountain Resort
reviews.subject: Example Mountain Resort
reviews.verdict: Beautiful setting, uneven value. Go midweek.
reviews.who_for: Hikers who do not need nightlife.
reviews.method: Three nights over a weekend, plus a revisit midweek the following month.
reviews.acquired: Paid the public rate. Booked directly under a regular name.
flaws: Weekend prices are high for what you get
body: Compare weekend and midweek stays so readers can decide when to book.

reviews.title: Sample Restaurant Review: Example Trattoria
reviews.subject: Example Trattoria
reviews.verdict: What to order, what to avoid, and whether it is worth the price.
reviews.who_for: A relaxed dinner for two or a small group.
reviews.method: Visited twice: a Tuesday and a Saturday. Ordered full meals each time.
reviews.acquired: Paid the full bill both times. Reserved under a normal name and did not say I write reviews.
flaws: Service pacing slowed on the busy night
body: Describe dishes concretely: temperature, seasoning, portion and price.
Note the date and day of each visit.

reviews.title: Sample Restaurant Review: Example Noodle Bar
reviews.subject: Example Noodle Bar
reviews.verdict: Fast and cheap. Good, not special.
reviews.acquired: Paid in full. Nobody there knew I was reviewing.
body: Short, plain reviews are fine for simple places. Keep the structure the same so readers can compare.

reviews.title: Sample Wine Review: Example Estate Red 2020
reviews.subject: Example Estate Red
reviews.verdict: Whether the bottle is worth its price, and when to drink it.
reviews.who_for: Weeknight dinners or a gift for someone who likes balanced reds.
reviews.method: Opened over two evenings, decanted for 30 minutes the first night, served at cellar temperature.
reviews.acquired: Bought at retail with my own money. No samples, no discounts for reviewers.
worked: A specific aroma or flavor, named concretely
flaws: Short finish on the second night
skip: Drinking it straight from the fridge
body: Describe the wine concretely: color, aroma, texture and finish.
Say how long it was open, how it changed and when you would drink the next bottle.
